description: Checks a job created by one of the image tools. Returns download_url once it is unlocked (API-key jobs are paid up front; anonymous ones by a human via unlock_url). Otherwise returns the status, preview_url and unlock_url. Never charges. Anonymous results expire 24h after creation unless claimed.

access_token.description: The access_token returned with the job.

name: get_result
title: Get the status or download link of an image job
